old_wrong_rule: Public proof class is a separate gate before process existence/action/execution can be accepted.
new_rule: Public proof/readback is an observer edge within the process state machine. It does not create the process; it records an externally observed state after or during execution.

process_model.PROCESS_DEFINED: mechanism, input, state, operation and output are specified
process_model.PROCESS_BOUND: mechanism is bound to artifact, route, service, VFS object, or actuator
process_model.PROCESS_EXECUTED: operation invoked and local state transition or side effect attempted/completed
process_model.PROCESS_SIGNALED: event, ledger row, route response, patch event, release marker or telemetry signal emitted
process_model.PUBLIC_PROJECTION_OBSERVED: public route observer reports projection state
process_model.PROMOTED: ORC/BrainK/IL-LLM accepts a reconciled state from available proof and observer edges

revoked: public proof required before process exists
public proof required before internal execution can occur
public proof required before actuator signal can be accepted
public availability as generic process-existence test
critical_invariant: Absence of a public observation narrows claims about public projection state; it does not erase independently evidenced process existence, execution, signaling, or internal state transition.
